summary: This is Unity Forge's company creed, a metaphor-rich statement of its diversity and inclusion philosophy. It sets out the company's purpose, vision, brand promise and an invitation to new employees, arguing that diversity is necessary for innovation and that inclusion weaves individuality into collective success.
one_line: Unity Forge's creed frames diversity and inclusion as the foundation of its purpose, vision, brand identity and workplace culture.
key_facts: Unity Forge was founded on the principle that the brightest flames are kindled from diverse sparks.
Unity Forge says it doesn't just manufacture widgets; it crafts a world of possibilities.
Unity Forge's stated purpose is to harness the expanse of human diversity to strengthen and beautify the fabric of the company.
Unity Forge believes diversity isn't just nice, it's necessary, and calls it the fertile soil from which innovation springs.
Unity Forge's team members come from the four corners of the Earth, each bringing unique perspectives, experiences and ideas.
Unity Forge's vision is a workplace where diversity is not an agenda but a natural state of being, and inclusion is the thread weaving individuality into success.
The vision extends beyond mere compliance and describes each individual as both an anchor and a sail.
Unity Forge describes itself as 'not just a workforce; we are a force that works.'
Unity Forge's brand promise is that it empowers every voice, respects every journey, and celebrates every victory, no matter how small.
Unity Forge says its commitment to diversity and inclusion is more than a policy and is etched into every product, service and interaction.
The closing invitation says there is a place for everyone, whether a 'fresh spark or a timeless flame,' and that people can be their authentic selves.
The Unity Forge logo is described as a promise, a commitment, and a celebration of the spectrum that is humanity.
